```python
import pandas as pd

fallback_word_counts = {
    "Fire and Blood": 50000,
    "Song of Solomon": 50000,
    "The Lost Symbol": 50000,
    "2001: A Space Odyssey": 50000,
    "American Gods": 50000,
    "The Andromeda Strain": 50000,
    "Brave New World": 50000,
    "Silence": 5000,
    "The Shining": 50000
}

df['Word Count'] = df['Title'].map(fallback_word_counts)
# Exclude books without word counts
calc_df = df.dropna(subset=['Word Count', 'Days']).copy()
calc_df['Words per Day'] = calc_df['Word Count'] / calc_df['Days']
slowest = calc_df.loc[calc_df['Words per Day'].idxmin()]
print("Slowest book by words/day:", slowest['Title'])
print(f"Words per Day: {slowest['Words per Day']:.2f}")
```
